issues.description: StockIngredient constructor parameter mismatch: the problem statement's UML and the solution repository define a three-argument constructor StockIngredient(String, int, int), but the template repository's StockIngredient class only provides a four-argument constructor StockIngredient(String, int, int, boolean strictValidation). The template's Main also contains a commented example that calls new StockIngredient(String, int, int). This inconsistency will cause compilation errors or confusion for students who follow the problem text or example code.
